title: 14 Days Of Burrito Meal Prep | High Protein Low Calorie
description:
Burritos For The Week‼️

These are so good, I eat them ALL week. Check out @menufit.app for healthier restaurant options and use code NOAH for a free trial!

Meal Plans linked in my bio ❤️

🔥Macros For Each:

595 Calories
44g Protein
12g Fat
77g Carbs

Ingredients for 14 Burritos:

Steak:

✅ - 1.8 KG Lean Steak (fully fat trimmed)

✅ - Salt & Pepper to taste

✅ - Paprika

✅ - Garlic Powder

✅ - Cumin

✅ - Tajín (heavily seasoned)

Other Filling:

✅ - 3 Cups Rice (DRY Measurement)

✅ - Full Bunch Chopped Cilantro

✅ - Juice of One Lime

✅ - 400g Low Fat Mexican Cheese

✅ - 14 Low Carb Tortillas

✅ - 2 Large Cans of Corn (drained)

Add whatever sauce you’d like! I just dipped mine in a left over green sauce I had but get creative!

#healthydiet #highprotein #mealprep #mealpreprecipes #healthyfood
